service.name: Live music for an engagement party
service.serviceType: A jazz duo, a Spanish guitarist, a singer with a guitar or a party band for engagement parties and the party after a proposal
service.description: Live music for an engagement party across Denver and the Front Range: a jazz duo playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA under the dinner with both families, a Spanish guitarist under a long table, a singer with a guitar who learns the couple's song for the night, and a trio or quartet for the engagement party that dances, at home, on a patio or in a private dining space, with the same duo available for the wedding's cocktail hour on one contract and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can we hire a band for an engagement party?
faqs.a: Yes. Most engagement parties are a dinner or a cocktail party for forty, so a jazz duo, a Spanish guitarist or a singer with a guitar plays the evening, and a trio or a quartet plays the party the friends throw. It's one contract with one personal contact, booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

faqs.q: Can the same musicians play the engagement party and the wedding?
faqs.a: Yes, on one contract. The duo from the engagement party can play the cocktail hour, and the singer who learned the couple's song already has it for the first dance. Tell us both dates when you write.

Quiet enough for two families who've just met to hear each other across the table, and the musicians stop for each toast. An announcement microphone is ready for whichever parent stands up first. A trio at the friends' party plays dinner at that level and turns up once the floor opens.

faqs.q: Can the band play on a patio?
faqs.a: Yes, under cover, with a wall socket through the nearest window. A singer with a guitar takes about 6 by 4 feet on one circuit, a duo 8 by 6 and a trio 12 by 8, and once the sun goes down the loud part of a patio party moves indoors or to the DJ. A certificate of insurance and a W-9 come with the quote if you need them.
